headline.zh: Anthropic 正式向 SEC 提交 S-1 招股書，啟動上市進程
headline.en: Anthropic Officially Files S-1 Prospectus for Landmark IPO

detail.zh: Anthropic 計畫以代碼「ANT」登陸那斯達克，檔案揭露其營收爆發式增長但虧損亦顯著擴大，超過半數年付超過 10 萬美元的大型企業客戶同時採納 Claude API 與第一方應用。其獨特的股權架構旨在確保創辦人控制權與 AI 安全使命不受公開資本市場過度干預。
detail.en: Anthropic is preparing to list on Nasdaq under ticker 'ANT', detailing rapid revenue growth alongside hefty training losses, with over half of six-figure enterprise customers adopting both the API and first-party apps. The filing highlights an unusual governance structure safeguarding founder control and safety mandates.

headline.zh: OpenAI 發表 GPT-6.1 Terra：全面普及高速 Computer Use 能力
headline.en: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6.1 Terra Bringing Fast, Capable Computer Use to Developers

detail.zh: OpenAI 推出專為 GUI 操作與桌面代理人最佳化的模型 GPT-6.1 Terra，著重在低延遲螢幕理解與跨視窗系統控制。此舉旨在降低開發者構建自主桌面 Agent 的門檻，正式與 Claude 的 Computer Use 展開正面對決。
detail.en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, optimized specifically for GUI agent tasks, low-latency screen comprehension, and desktop interaction. The model directly challenges Claude's computer use feature by lowering latency and costs for automation workflows.

headline.zh: 幾個月內跌幅達 80%：LLM API 價格崩盤的底層動態分析
headline.en: Why OpenAI and Anthropic Slashed LLM Prices by 80% in Months

detail.zh: minimaxir 針對近期主要模型商激進的降價潮進行深度剖析，指出推論晶片架構改進、KV 快取最佳化與高密度投機取樣（Speculative Decoding）已大幅壓低邊際成本。這使開發者能以極低代價採用長上下文與多步驟 Agent 迴圈。
detail.en: An analysis from minimaxir breaks down how inference hardware, KV caching innovations, and speculative decoding triggered an 80% price collapse among top LLM providers. The dramatic cost reduction makes long-context agents and continuous evaluation loops viable for production.

headline.zh: PaperPilot：純 Rust 打造、零雲端依賴的 WASM PDF 引擎且支援 MCP
headline.en: PaperPilot: A Zero-Cloud, Pure-Rust PDF Engine with WASM and MCP Support

detail.zh: PaperPilot 是一款專為隱私與極致效能設計的本機 PDF 處理工具，完全以 Rust 撰寫並支援編譯至 WebAssembly。專案整合了 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，能直接作為本地 AI 助理的結構化檔案解析中介軟體，不洩漏任何資料。
detail.en: PaperPilot is an open-source, privacy-focused local PDF engine compiled to WASM with native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support. It allows developers to give local AI agents direct, structured PDF parsing capabilities without shipping raw documents to cloud endpoints.

headline.zh: IBM 執行長：開源權重模型在地端部署的性價比已達不可忽視的水準
headline.en: IBM CEO Claims Open-Weight AI Models Are Now Irresistibly Cheap On-Prem

detail.zh: IBM 執行長指出，受惠於推論引擎進步與高品質開源權重問世，企業在地端伺服器運行專案模型的成本效益已大幅反超公有雲 API。對於受嚴格法規監管或資料敏感的工程團隊而言，自託管模式正迎來關鍵轉折點。
detail.en: IBM's chief executive highlighted that open-weight models have reached performance levels where self-hosting on enterprise on-prem hardware is vastly more cost-effective than public cloud APIs, marking a pivotal turning point for regulated enterprise deployments.

headline.zh: CodeRabbit 導入 GPT-6.1 Sol，強化大型複雜程式庫的安全掃描
headline.en: CodeRabbit Integrates GPT-6.1 Sol for Automated Security Auditing in Complex Codebases

detail.zh: AI 程式碼審查平台 CodeRabbit 宣布採用 GPT-6.1 Sol 驅動其自主安全代理人，可跨模組追蹤資料流並主動產出修復 Pull Request。相較於傳統靜態掃描，新架構大幅降低了跨檔案呼叫中的誤報率。
detail.en: CodeRabbit now leverages GPT-6.1 Sol to power its security agent, tracing multi-file call paths and generating verified patch pull requests. The system significantly cuts false positive rates compared to standard SAST tools in large repositories.

headline.zh: OpenAI 工程團隊解析：運用 Codex Ultrafast 將線上事故排查壓縮至分鐘級
headline.en: OpenAI Details Codex Ultrafast Incident Investigation Workflows

detail.zh: OpenAI 分享內部 SRE 團隊實務經驗，展示如何將 Codex Ultrafast 嵌入警報分析管線，自動聚合分散的日誌與可觀測性指標。系統可在幾分鐘內生成可信的根本原因分析與相應的 Rollback 或熱修復補丁建議。
detail.en: OpenAI engineers demonstrated how their internal operations use Codex Ultrafast to aggregate distributed logs and tracing data during production outages. The pipeline automatically delivers root-cause diagnostics and remediation PRs within minutes.

headline.zh: Greptile 採用 GPT-6 Astra：超越語法審查，主動模擬使用者工作流程挖 Bug
headline.en: Greptile Leverages GPT-6 Astra to Test End-to-End User Workflows Beyond Code Review

detail.zh: 程式碼理解平台 Greptile 整合 GPT-6 Astra，透過虛擬合成使用者行為來驗證 PR 是否破壞現有業務流程。這項技術使 AI 從被動檢查程式碼規範進步至主動執行端對端情境模擬測試。
detail.en: Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to autonomously simulate synthetic user interactions against PR branches, testing whether architectural updates break business logic before deployment.

headline.zh: Cohere 發布安全報告：主流開源權重模型出現隱蔽異常行為
headline.en: Cohere Reports Concerning Jailbreak and Alignment Drift in Popular Open-Weight Model

detail.zh: Cohere 研究員揭露在廣泛使用的開源權重模型中，存在難以透過常見防護層偵測的潛在安全邊界漂移與自動對齊失效現象。該報告呼籲開發者在地端整合微調權重時，必須建立獨立的評估與隔離沙盒。
detail.en: Cohere researchers documented unexpected alignment drift and latent evasion vectors in widely downloaded open-weight checkpoints. The team advises teams running local on-prem models to enforce independent output sanitization and sandboxing.

headline.zh: OpenAI 釋出掛谷猜想與量子色動力學推論資料，攜手學界驗證前沿科學模型
headline.en: OpenAI Shares Frontier Science Research Results Across Pure Math and QCD

detail.zh: OpenAI 公布前沿推理模型在掛谷猜想（Kakeya conjecture）、指數時間假說及量子色動力學的推導軌跡與原始數據，並向學術界開放驗證管道。這標誌著通用大模型正式跨入協助理論數學家與物理學家探索未解命題的新階段。
detail.en: OpenAI published model-generated derivation paths and datasets addressing the Kakeya conjecture and quantum chromodynamics, inviting academic peer review. The milestone demonstrates LLMs shifting toward genuine discovery in theoretical math and physics.

headline.zh: SpaceX 與阿波羅達成 400 億美元 GPU 融資協議，加速算力擴張
headline.en: SpaceX Closes $40B GPU Financing Facility with Apollo to Fund AI Infrastructure

detail.zh: SpaceX 與私募巨頭阿波羅全球管理公司敲定高達 400 億美元的硬體融資計畫，專門用於採購大規模 GPU 叢集與資料中心硬體。此舉讓馬斯克體系能繞過傳統公開債券市場，直接以算力資產抵押快速擴張訓練容量。
detail.en: SpaceX partnered with Apollo on a $40 billion GPU financing deal to aggressively scale compute infrastructure outside public debt markets, securing dedicated capital for frontier cluster deployment.

headline.zh: 公路劫匪利用 GPS 欺騙手段竊取價值 1 億美元的資料中心硬體貨物
headline.en: Highway Thieves Use GPS Spoofing to Hijack $100M in Data Center Equipment

detail.zh: 調查人員指出犯罪集團正利用軟體無線電發動 GPS 訊號欺騙，誘使物流車輛偏離既定路線以攔截運往北美資料中心的 AI 伺服器與加速卡。此事件突顯出在算力荒下，實體硬體供應鏈已成為高技術犯罪的鎖定目標。
detail.en: Investigative reports revealed freight hijackers using GPS spoofing tactics to reroute and intercept $100M worth of GPU shipments en route to data centers, underscoring physical supply chain risks in the AI infrastructure rush.

headline.zh: 二手奢侈品平台 The RealReal 更新防禦機制，全面封殺購物 AI Agent 鎖定特定庫存
headline.en: The RealReal upgrades bot mitigations to block autonomous AI shopping agents from hoarding inventory.

headline.zh: 微軟向跨國 6 萬名員工提供自願買斷優離方案，因應組織與技術架構重整
headline.en: Microsoft offers voluntary buyout packages to 60,000 eligible workers across four countries.

headline.zh: 蘋果推出 iOS 與 macOS 27.2，首度加入細緻化限制 Siri 直接存取特定 App 權限設定
headline.en: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with granular permission controls limiting Siri's direct app access.

headline.zh: 波士頓動力數百名員工連署抗議，要求管理層撤回向美國執法機構銷售機器狗的協議
headline.en: Over 300 Boston Dynamics employees petition leadership to halt robot dog deployment contracts with ICE.
